literal: familiar friendship what will do intimacy having done in that way not accepting if
translation: What is the use of a long-standing friendship if one does not accept the liberties taken by a friend?
modern: நண்பர்கள் உரிமையோடு செய்யும் செயல்களை அப்படியே ஏற்றுக்கொள்ளாவிட்டால் நெடுங்காலமாகப் பழகிய நட்பினால் என்ன பயன்?
explanation: This couplet questions the value of an old friendship if friends cannot tolerate the liberties taken by each other. The phrase kezhutakaimai refers to the intimate right to act freely without asking permission. If a friend acts with such intimacy and the other does not accept it gracefully, the long-standing bond loses its meaning. True friendship requires embracing the actions done out of deep familiarity.
